text:
For your 40-minute train commute, podcasts that blend literary analysis with engaging storytelling would be ideal. Given your love for both classic and contemporary fiction, "The Book Review" from The New York Times offers deep dives into new releases and classics, often featuring author interviews. "99% Invisible" might also appeal if you enjoy the narrative structure of stories, though it focuses on design. For pure author interviews and book club discussions, "The Bookworm" or "Literary Friction" are excellent choices that fit well within a 40-minute window, allowing you to finish an episode or two during your ride.

The meal that comes second in the day, after breakfast, is lunch.
